transcript.text: Mr. and Mrs. Peter had to go out that night for dinner with some friends.
Therefore, to take care of their two boys, they arranged for a babysitter.
The babysitter was supposed to arrive at 8, but by 10 past 8, she hadn't arrived yet.
Suddenly, the doorbell rang.
Hi Samara, thanks for coming.
We'll be home late, maybe around 1 in the morning.
Please feed the kids and put them to bed by 9.30.
I've prepared some snacks for the kids and put them in the fridge.
If they give you a hard time sleeping, read them a story or something.
All the storybooks are in their room.
If there is any issue, please call us.
You have our number.
Bye kids, see you later and be good, okay?
Bye, enjoy your dinner.
Samara fed the kids and put them to bed at 9.30.
By 10.30, the kids were fast asleep.
After putting the kids to bed, she came downstairs in the sitting room to watch TV.
While watching the TV, Samara felt a presence behind her.
She turned around to check and found a clown doll on the other side of the room.
It was unsettling to find something like that in the room.
She felt as if the clown doll was staring back at her.
Then she reminded herself that it was just a doll.
It's late at night and I'm sitting here all alone in the room.
Maybe that's why I'm having all these creepy feelings.
After dismissing these thoughts, she continued watching TV to calm herself.
After a while, she heard someone breathing heavily.
This terrified her and she muted the TV.
But there was dead silence.
It was quiet throughout the house.
Also there was no sound coming from the kids room.
When she turned up the volume of the TV again, thinking it was all in her mind.
While watching TV, she had the feeling of eyes burning in the back of her skull.
She felt that the doll was continuously watching her.
A chill went down her spine.
It was getting creepier and creepier.
Eventually, she got sick of all these feelings and decided to move the doll into another room.
After moving the doll to another room, she came back to the sitting room and continued watching
TV.
Now Samara was feeling very relaxed and comfortable.
All those creepy feelings that she was experiencing because of the doll were all gone.
After a short while, Samara's phone rang.
It was Mrs. Peter calling.
Hi Samara, how's everything?
Did you put the kids to bed on time?
Yes Mrs. Peter, everything is fine, the kids were great, they didn't give me any trouble,
they had their food and slept on time.
One minute Mrs. Peter, I wanted to tell you something, sounds a bit funny, but your clown doll
that was in the sitting room, I have moved it into another room.
I don't know why I was feeling a little uncomfortable watching TV without being in the room.
I thought I'd tell you, if that's okay.
Samara, what clown doll?
We don't have any clown doll in our sitting room?
